description: Regression tests untuk prompt generator SQL readonly domain sales M5.

tests.question: Daftar 20 penawaran penjualan terbaru beserta customer dan total transaksinya
tests.expected_sql_shape: SELECT ... FROM m5_sq LEFT JOIN m1_contact ... ORDER BY sqtgl DESC LIMIT 20

tests.question: Tampilkan item barang pada sales order tertentu beserta qty dan harga
tests.expected_sql_shape: SELECT ... FROM m5_so JOIN m5_so_detail ON sod.idso = so.soid WHERE so.sonotransaksi = ?

tests.question: Tampilkan progres dokumen dari quotation ke sales order dan delivery order untuk setiap item quotation
tests.expected_sql_shape: SELECT ... FROM m5_sq_detail LEFT JOIN m5_so_detail ... LEFT JOIN m5_do_detail ...

tests.question: Daftar invoice penjualan yang belum lunas beserta nilai total dan jumlah pembayarannya
tests.expected_sql_shape: SELECT ... FROM m5_si WHERE sijmlbayar < sitotaltransaksi

tests.question: Daftar tagihan invoice collection yang berasal dari sales invoice
tests.expected_sql_shape: SELECT ... FROM m5_ic_detail JOIN m5_si ON icd.sumber = 'SI' AND icd.idtransaksi = si.siid

tests.question: Daftar payment voucher yang membayar sales return
tests.expected_sql_shape: SELECT ... FROM m5_pv JOIN m5_pv_detail ... JOIN m5_sr ON pvd.sumber = 'SR' AND pvd.idtransaksi = sr.srid

tests.question: Tampilkan dokumen tukar faktur penjualan beserta invoice dan retur sumbernya
must_have_conditions: m5_sie_detail.sumber checked before joining to target document
tests.expected_sql_shape: SELECT ... FROM m5_sie JOIN m5_sie_detail ... LEFT JOIN m5_si ... LEFT JOIN m5_sr ...

tests.question: Daftar customer dengan penyesuaian poin penjualan terbesar
tests.expected_sql_shape: SELECT ... FROM m5_spa JOIN m5_spa_detail LEFT JOIN m1_contact ... ORDER BY poinbaru DESC LIMIT 100

tests.question: Daftar piutang ongkos kirim per invoice penjualan
tests.expected_sql_shape: SELECT ... FROM m5_rp JOIN m5_si ON rp.rpidsi = si.siid

tests.question: Tampilkan status realisasi per item customer dari sales order sampai invoice
tests.expected_sql_shape: SELECT ... FROM m5_cl LEFT JOIN m5_so ... LEFT JOIN m1_contact ... LEFT JOIN m1_item ...
